import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_78/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_78/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_78/training_2.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)

# First join Source0 and Source1 on Prod_id
df01 = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Prod_id", how="left")

# Then join the result with Source2 on Cust_id
df_final = pd.merge(df01, df2, on="Cust_id", how="left", suffixes=('_prod', '_cust'))

# After join, columns from Source2 have suffix _cust, but some columns from Source1 and Source2 overlap in names
# We want to keep the columns from Source2 (Customer_Name, Province, Region, Customer_Segment) without suffixes
# and drop duplicated columns from Source0/Source1 that have suffix _prod or _cust if any.

# Columns to keep from Source2 (with _cust suffix)
cust_cols = ['Customer_Name', 'Province', 'Region', 'Customer_Segment']
cust_cols_renamed = {col + '_cust': col for col in cust_cols}

# Rename these columns to original names
df_final = df_final.rename(columns=cust_cols_renamed)

# Drop any columns with suffix _prod if they duplicate the above columns (should not exist, but just in case)
drop_cols = [col for col in df_final.columns if col.endswith('_prod')]
df_final = df_final.drop(columns=drop_cols)

# Also drop any other duplicated columns from the join that are not needed
# For safety, drop 'Unnamed: 0' if present (sometimes appears after merges)
if 'Unnamed: 0' in df_final.columns:
    df_final = df_final.drop(columns=['Unnamed: 0'])

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly:
target_columns = [
    'Ord_id', 'Prod_id', 'Ship_id', 'Cust_id', 'Sales', 'Discount', 'Order_Quantity', 'Profit',
    'Shipping_Cost', 'Product_Base_Margin', 'Product_Category', 'Product_Sub_Category',
    'Customer_Name', 'Province', 'Region', 'Customer_Segment'
]

df_final = df_final[target_columns]

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
df_final = df_final.astype({
    'Ord_id': str,
    'Prod_id': str,
    'Ship_id': str,
    'Cust_id': str,
    'Sales': float,
    'Discount': float,
    'Order_Quantity': int,
    'Profit': float,
    'Shipping_Cost': float,
    'Product_Base_Margin': float,
    'Product_Category': str,
    'Product_Sub_Category': str,
    'Customer_Name': str,
    'Province': str,
    'Region': str,
    'Customer_Segment': str
})

# Write the final dataframe to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_78/target_multisource.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
